q: Do you really offer a fixed quote, with no hidden charges?
a: Absolutely. After a free site survey, MITRA gives you a fully itemised quote covering materials, labor, and installation. If site conditions require any alterations during execution, we get your written approval first — the base contract price never changes without your sign-off.

q: What is the minimum budget you work with?
a: MITRA works with projects starting from a single modular wardrobe (under ₹1L) up to full-scale villa construction. Our Essential tier is engineered specifically for tighter budgets, selecting cost-effective but durable, verified BWP plywood and soft-close hardware.

q: How long does a typical home interior project take?
a: A modular kitchen typically takes 25 days from final design sign-off. Full home interior projects take 60–90 days depending on the structural and civil scope. Handover dates are put in writing and tracked on a weekly timeline.

q: What warranty do you provide on craftsmanship and materials?
a: We offer a 3-year warranty on modular kitchen and wardrobe hardware, a 7-year warranty on full home interior installations, and a 10-year structural warranty on new construction and major civil works.

q: Can I inspect the materials before the installation begins?
a: Yes. Every quotation clearly states the exact brand and grade of plywood, laminate, veneer, and hardware fittings. You are welcome to visit our material studio to touch and verify everything before finalising your designs.
